run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if any pair in an array has a product equal to target x
test_f_gold: test f_gold against candidate solution f_filled using the built-in parameter sets
summarize_f_gold: summarize the brute-force pair product search algorithm in f_gold
review_f_gold: review f_gold for time complexity and suggest an optimized approach
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a hash set for O(n) pair product lookup
